name: Popees Cares Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2024, Popees Cares Ltd is a baby care company that sells  products online and in physical stores[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
PCL was in the business of software and fabrics but after its acquisition, the management changed the business to baby care products. Currently, the co. offers a wide range of products including clothing for newborns and infants, Fabric wash, Baby wipes, Shampoo, Body wash,  Soap, Diapers, Toys, and Accessories, etc.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
